research.facts:
Cubs Not Chasing Skubal — King Is the Real Target
**Facts (MEDIUM confidence):**
- Tarik Skubal was traded from Tigers to Dodgers at 2026 trade deadline (confirmed by multiple sources)
- Skubal is a Scott Boras client; $400M+ market projected (confirmed by CBS Sports/BN)
- Cubs insider report (ClutchPoints): Cubs "are not likely to get involved" in Skubal bidding
- Cubs already committed ~$110M in future contracts (ClutchPoints source)
- Skubal has loose bodies in elbow requiring surgery (CBS Sports, Oct 2026)
- Michael King: 3.23 ERA, 27 starts in 2026 (confirmed, ESPN/MLB.com)
- King's opt-out: due 5 days after WS; widely expected to opt out (MLB.com, Aug 29 2026)
- King is "widely viewed as second-best starting pitcher on this winter's FA market behind Skubal" per MLB.com
**Notes:** King opt-out not confirmed yet (WS hasn't started). Cubs interest in King is prior reporting (10/11 covered). Do NOT state King opt-out as confirmed.
**Sources:**
- ClutchPoints (Oct 2026): Cubs insider Skubal report
- MLB.com Mark Feinsand (Aug 29 2026): King opt-out likelihood
- Bleacher Report offseason guide (Oct 2026): mentions King and Joe Ryan
- Gaslamp Ball: King opt-out background

research.facts:
Seiya Suzuki to Blue Jays — Cubs Won't Match
**Facts (MEDIUM confidence):**
- Mitch Bannon (The Athletic): Blue Jays expected to pursue Suzuki this offseason
- QO amount: $23.15M (Joel Sherman, New York Post — confirmed BN cited same figure)
- Cubs unlikely to match per inside report: "unlikely to get into a bidding war for Suzuki's services"
- Suzuki market: expected 5yr/$130M+ range
- Cubs face the QO dilemma: extend it (lose draft pick if he rejects) or don't (lose him for nothing)
- Comparable: Santander 5yr/$92.5M (Blue Jays), Schwarber 5yr/$150M (Phillies)
**Note:** No final QO decision has been made yet. World Series hasn't started. Do NOT frame as a completed transaction.
**Sources:**
- The Athletic (Mitch Bannon): Blue Jays interest in Suzuki
- Bleacher Nation (Oct 2026): QO analysis + Cubs' payroll situation
